decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API runs on the firm's existing messaging cloud and costs little to maintain, and its continued dedicated page shows the option is still alive, so keeping it open is sensible while enterprise demand for it becomes clearer.
Launched only in 2024 as a low-cost extension of the established email and messaging infrastructure, the email-to-SMS gateway has not yet revealed enough about its value to justify abandoning it.

The SMS-to-email gateway complements Products A and B on the same platform, so it adds little marginal cost and keeps a cheap option on integrated multichannel communication open while uncertainty about it resolves.
